description: Source records for the landing page images. The simulation poster is copied unchanged; the architectural hall is encoded as lossless WebP with identical decoded RGBA pixels.

images.note: The poster shows the sampled browser variant, not all particles in the original simulation. Its source caption is preserved.
A repository render of the hall's architecture. This is not a browser screenshot or evidence of headset rendering quality.

encoding.pixel_verification: Source and encoded image have identical decoded RGBA bytes.
encoding.command: uv run python -c "from PIL import Image; source = Image.open('docs/img/palace-still-hall.png'); source.save('grove/public/site/hall.webp', format='WEBP', lossless=True, method=6, exact=True); encoded = Image.open('grove/public/site/hall.webp'); assert source.convert('RGBA').tobytes() == encoded.convert('RGBA').tobytes()"
